@graph.description: Milk thistle (Silybum marianum) is a spiny plant whose seeds yield silymarin, a mixture of flavonolignans with antioxidant activity. Although it is best known as a 'liver tonic,' rigorous evidence for liver disease is limited and inconclusive; its clearer signal is metabolic. A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials in type 2 diabetes found that silymarin reduced fasting blood glucose and HbA1c compared with control, while not significantly changing blood lipids. The included trials were few and small, so larger studies are needed. Milk thistle is generally well tolerated.
